💻 🍎 Using a Lenovo / Windows laptop with Apple Calendar?

Because Lenovo laptops run Windows, there is no Mac “Apple Calendar” menu bar with File > Export. Instead, you can grab your Apple Calendar in 10 seconds via your iPhone or web link:

Option A (Fastest via iPhone):
  1. On your iPhone, open the Calendar app.
  2. Tap Calendars (bottom center) > tap the ⓘ icon next to your school calendar.
  3. Turn ON Public Calendar > tap Share Link > copy the link.
  4. Paste that link below and click Download .ics File!
📂
Upload Apple Calendar or Google Calendar (.ics) file

Drag & drop your .ics file here, or click to choose from your computer

How to export from Apple Calendar or Google Calendar
Apple Calendar (Mac): Select your calendar in the left sidebar > click File > Export > Export... (or drag the calendar to your desktop) > drop that .ics file here!
Google Calendar: Go to Settings (gear) > Import & export > Export > unzip the downloaded folder and select your course .ics file here.

Why links starting with “file:///” don't work for friends:

You are running this planner from your laptop's local drive (file:///Users/ari/...). Because this link points to your private computer, friends clicking it from their laptops will see a “File not found” error.

Full Planner Backup & Transfer

💡 How to put this planner online for anyone to use (Free in 2 min)

Because app.html is completely self-contained with no servers or accounts required, you can host it anywhere for free:

  1. GitHub Pages: Create a free repository on GitHub, upload app.html renamed as index.html, and enable Pages in repository settings.
  2. Netlify Drop: Go to netlify.com/drop and drag-and-drop this HTML file for an instant public URL.
  3. Direct file sharing: You can also email, message, or AirDrop the app.html file directly to classmates!
